prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man with dark curly hair wearing a white T-shirt in <Picture 1>.
<Object 1> is the pair of silver wraparound sunglasses shown from three angles in <Picture 2>.
<Picture 3> is the scene reference: a warmly lit traditional Japanese dining room with a family gathered around a low table.

summary:
[subject reference + object reference + scene reference] <Subject 1>, wearing <Object 1>, joins the family dinner in the dining room of <Picture 3> and greets everyone.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, medium wide shot, gentle handheld drift. <Subject 1> slides open the paper door of the dining room from <Picture 3>, <Object 1> pushed up on his forehead. He smiles, lowers the sunglasses, bows slightly and says: "Sorry I'm late, the train was packed." The family laughs and makes room for him at the low table while steam rises from the bowls of ramen.
overall_soundscape: Soft family chatter, clinking ceramic bowls, the slide of a paper door and the hiss of a simmering pot.
non_diegetic_music: None.
